sources.title: Da Vinci instruments
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: Honda ASIMO 人形機器人
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付主從座標圖、縮放表及無人體紙上描線紀錄。；教學描線接受比例誤差≤2%且返回誤差≤0.1 mm；不得轉寫成醫療器材允收標準。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver master–slave frames, scaling table and nonclinical paper tracing record.; Teaching tracing accepts scale error≤2% and closure≤0.1 mm; these are not medical-device acceptance limits.
related.difference: 用線性倒單擺模型估計水平加速度對支撐點需求的影響。
related.differenceEn: Estimate how horizontal acceleration shifts the required support point in a linear inverted-pendulum model.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 理想位移縮放 xs=xm/r，輸入位移誤差也除以 r，但末端機械誤差不會因此消失。；教學 xm=10 mm、比例 r=5、主控量測不確定量 0.20 mm。；xs=10/5=2 mm；輸入誤差映射為 0.20/5=0.04 mm。
定高度近似下 xZMP=xCOM−z ax/g，支撐點需落在支撐多邊形。；教學 xCOM=0、z=0.50 m、ax=0.80 m/s²，支撐區間 ±0.06 m。；xZMP=0−0.50×0.80/9.81=−0.040775 m，位於區間內。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal scaling is xs=xm/r; input error also divides by r, while downstream mechanical error remains.; Teaching xm=10 mm, r=5 and master measurement uncertainty 0.20 mm.; xs=10/5=2 mm; mapped input error is 0.20/5=0.04 mm.

At constant height, xZMP=xCOM−z ax/g; the support point must lie within the support polygon.; Teaching xCOM=0, z=0.50 m, ax=0.80 m/s² and support interval ±0.06 m.; xZMP=−0.50×0.80/9.81=−0.040775 m, inside the interval.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Stratasys FDM 熱塑成形平台
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付主從座標圖、縮放表及無人體紙上描線紀錄。；教學描線接受比例誤差≤2%且返回誤差≤0.1 mm；不得轉寫成醫療器材允收標準。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver master–slave frames, scaling table and nonclinical paper tracing record.; Teaching tracing accepts scale error≤2% and closure≤0.1 mm; these are not medical-device acceptance limits.
related.difference: 用懸臂試片比較列印方向的等效剛度，避免把材料視為各向同性。
related.differenceEn: Compare print-direction stiffness with a cantilever coupon instead of assuming isotropy.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 理想位移縮放 xs=xm/r，輸入位移誤差也除以 r，但末端機械誤差不會因此消失。；教學 xm=10 mm、比例 r=5、主控量測不確定量 0.20 mm。；xs=10/5=2 mm；輸入誤差映射為 0.20/5=0.04 mm。
I=bh³/12，端點剛度 k=3EI/L³；方向效應先以等效 E 表示。；教學 E=1500 N/mm²、b=10 mm、h=4 mm、L=50 mm。；I=10×4³/12=53.333 mm⁴；k=3×1500×53.333/50³=1.92 N/mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Ideal scaling is xs=xm/r; input error also divides by r, while downstream mechanical error remains.; Teaching xm=10 mm, r=5 and master measurement uncertainty 0.20 mm.; xs=10/5=2 mm; mapped input error is 0.20/5=0.04 mm.
I=bh³/12 and tip stiffness k=3EI/L³; orientation is represented by effective E.; Teaching E=1500 N/mm², b=10 mm, h=4 mm and L=50 mm.; I=53.333 mm⁴; k=3×1500×53.333/50³=1.92 N/mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
